name: MSN LPBonus accrues FIST rewards at a manipulated pair reserve
summary: MSN's transfer hooks drive LPBonus, which on each fee accrual adds swapped FIST to a per-share index divided by the FIST/MSN pair's live MSN reserve, and pays LP removals from that index. With flash-swapped FIST the attacker registered an LP position, crushed the pair's MSN reserve, let an accrual run at the crushed reserve, and removed dust LP to claim 1.44m FIST against about 0.94m funded, draining LPBonus's FIST.
notes: Both contracts are unverified; the mechanism follows the PoC's bytecode reading and the trace. The reset is the owner setting the FIST/MSN pair in LPBonus and MSN (one tx, 31 blocks after LPBonus's deployment); MSN's later OpenAddLiquidity and setStartTradeTime only opened the product.

Loss is LPBonus's net FIST outflow at DefiLlama's price; the attacker realised 92,607 USDT after its sale and fees. Before the anchor no transaction took more than about 20k FIST from LPBonus (scan of its FIST transfers since deployment, nine 5k-block ranges unscanned).
